data.name: Brahmajit
data.gender_notes: Brahmajit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Brahmajit is a name derived from Sanskrit origin. It is a name of Lord Brahma, the creator of the universe in Hinduism. The name Brahmajit carries the meaning “Lord of Brahma” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Brahmajit usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of brahma and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Brahmajit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Brahma.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brahmajit total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
